[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I think we found it.[XENO:n ]
Is this the Piezoelectric Unit?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes, that's it. Well done.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Linada-san, what does this mean for Fiorung?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

It will just take me a little time to[XENO:n ]
reconfigure and install the unit.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Leave it to me. You get some rest.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Shulk, do you want her to see you looking[XENO:n ]
exhausted when she wakes up?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

You're right. I'll try and get some rest.[XENO:n ]
Thank you for everything you're doing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The chief says he wants to speak with you.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I think it's about Egil.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I'll go and see him.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]He wants Egil stopped, and so do we.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
But I need to sleep on it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Good. You mustn't overburden yourself.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
We will help you in any way we can.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
